description: The mode-registry release index (spec-20260905-063000 D1): the vsix-tag → registry-revision mapping — the doctor's remote-compare authority, never origin HEAD. `current to vX` means the release the machine's build corresponds to; a machine whose revision is below the newest release's renders `current to vX, stale to release vY`. registry_revision = 0 marks a pre-registry release.

registry_revision.description: The mode-registry revision this release ships; 0 = the release predates the registry.

vsix_tag.description: The release tag (clean vX.Y.Z or internal vX.Y.Z-alpha.N).

title: mode-registry release index (release-index.toml)
